chunks: Everything in it that is from Maʿmar ibn Khallād, I have narrated from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil; and Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh; and Aḥmad ibn Ziyād ibn Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī—may Allah be pleased with them—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Maʿmar ibn Khallād.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ: may Allah be pleased with them; a supplicatory honorific for the named transmitters
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an explicit statement of narration by the author
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: from his father; a familial link within the sanad/isnad
key_terms.عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ خَلَّادٍ: from Maʿmar ibn Khallād; the named point of transmission in this chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Maʿmar ibn Khallād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad for the author’s transmissions from Maʿmar ibn Khallād in the book. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission through named teachers and intermediaries, which is essential in hadith preservation and verification.
